name: Ruswar
source:
A mechanical butler who was born with Matan.

His life has been excellent, but he often wonders what it would be like if he lived comfortably.

Meanwhile, he meets Rosario and Lily.

"I have to return the grace I received ... Isn't it bad to wake up?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
